description: Self-contained Salesforce REST API workhorse. OAuth 2.0 password grant against a Connected App, retry on 401 (token refresh) / 429 / 5xx. Convenience methods for read (soql cursor, describe_sobject, get_record, find_record) + write (create_record, update_record, upsert_record via native External-ID, composite_upsert, delete_record).

outputs.description: SalesforceResource with read + write convenience methods. Consumed by salesforce_record_upsert (sink) and by custom Dagster asset code that needs SOQL / SObject CRUD.

security_token_env_var.label: Security Token Env Var
security_token_env_var.description: Optional. Appended to password at auth time — required for IP-restricted orgs.

consumer_key_env_var.label: Consumer Key Env Var
consumer_key_env_var.description: From Setup → App Manager → Connected App.

consumer_secret_env_var.label: Consumer Secret Env Var
consumer_secret_env_var.description: From Setup → App Manager → Connected App.

name: Salesforce Resource
